description: Per-video rows from the saved YouTube reports: top videos by views for one fixed period (default 28 days) and recent videos by publish date, each with title, video id, publish date, length and the same metrics as get_youtube_channel_report. Only videos YouTube returned in a saved top list (up to 20 per 7/28/90-day period) are known, so recent is not a full upload list. Video subscriber figures cover that video's watch page. Read-only; never calls YouTube.

format.description: Output shape: table (default) or raw json.

limit.description: Max rows for top and recent (default 20).

period.description: YouTube's fixed report window in days: 7, 28 or 90.

name: get_youtube_videos
